name: execute
description: Write JavaScript that calls cloudflare.request() against a discovered Cloudflare API path. Use for live account reads (RUM site list, Workers, DNS). Do not invent site tokens or mutate IaC-managed resources without user approval.

code.description: JavaScript that calls cloudflare.request({ method, path, body? }). Listing RUM sites: GET `/accounts/${accountId}/rum/site_info/list` as async IIFE or return-await.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account id when the token cannot auto-detect it
